statusHistory.note: São Paulo/Baixada Santista content push (near-war-room), fulfilling open request sp-pinheiros-anchor -- Near's first Pinheiros pin. Operator-directed research pass (chat request) -> trust: auto per rules.md trust-gate. Verified via CNN Brasil and Taste & Fly editorial coverage plus the venue's own Espaces listing (address, hours, menu concept) -- all corroborate Rua Ferreira de Araújo, 333, chef Tássia Magalhães (Best Chef of Latin America 2025 per Taste & Fly) and sommelier Danyel Steinle, a sister project to their restaurant Nelita. Coverage reads as recent ('novo bar de vinhos'), Espaces listing shows current hours (Tue-Sun, closed Mon), no closure signal found -- satisfies verify-still-open-before-create. Coordinates approximate for the Rua Ferreira de Araújo block, not an independently verified geocode pin -- confidence 0.6. Hero image is a general Pinheiros street scene (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0), not venue-specific -- logged as an acceptable compromise pending a real interior/exterior photo of Lita itself.
